club.name: STOMP
club.tagline: Raw sound. Concrete floors. No last call.

events.title: Concrete Pulse
events.blurb: Hypnotic, low-slung techno until the sun comes up. Fog, strobes, and a wall of sub-bass.

events.title: Basement Tapes
events.blurb: Warm, dusty house records dug out of the crates. Intimate room, big heart.

events.title: STOMP x Noord Collective
events.blurb: Electro and breaks with a live hardware set. Visuals by the Noord AV crew.

events.title: Sunday Sediment
events.blurb: Daytime ambient and dub on the canal-side courtyard. Bring a friend, slow down.

events.title: Hard Matter
events.blurb: Fast, relentless, and loud. Earplugs at the door, no apologies.

events.title: Crate Diggers Market
events.blurb: Record fair by day with rotating selectors. Coffee, crates, and good company.
